name: get_current_user
description: Read the authenticated account's native identity and capability fields.

name: list_users
description:
List visible accounts: self for nonstaff, all native-visible users for staff.

        Optional search is a local case-insensitive substring match of username,
        first/last name or email after full pagination. Its count is local; no
        native search parameters or hidden-user discovery are used.

name: get_user
description: Read an account visible to the current self/staff native queryset.

name: create_user
description:
Create a native account row as staff, preserving omitted defaults.

        Acceptance does not establish a usable password login or send an
        invitation. Password setup, privilege changes and tokens are not fields
        of this operation; native email syntax and uniqueness remain authoritative.

UserCreate.description: Create a native account row; password setup and invitations are separate.
UserCreate.title: UserCreate

name: update_user
description:
Edit an account allowed by the native self/staff permissions.

        Own-email changes are permitted, without a verification-email guarantee.
        Self-deactivation may end access; username changes may affect login and
        sharing. Omitted fields remain unchanged; empty display names clear them.

UserPatch.description: Edit native account fields; empty display names deliberately clear them.
UserPatch.title: UserPatch

name: delete_user
description:
Delete an account and native dependent records; staff permission required.

        Self-deletion can end access. Collections, tags and reporting/download
        records may cascade, while owned content may lose its owner. Protected
        relationships can reject deletion; this is not a complete erasure report.

name: list_groups
description:
List all groups visible through current membership, including for staff.

        Optional case-insensitive name search runs locally after full pagination.
        Its count is the local match count; no native search parameter is sent.
        With no search, preserve the native collection shape and metadata.

name: get_group
description: Read a membership-visible group; staff has no arbitrary-group bypass.

name: create_group
description:
Create a native group, acknowledging possible missing membership/ownership.

        Required acknowledge_native_create_limitations=true accepts that the native
        REST endpoint may leave the creator outside an ownerless, inaccessible group.
        Send one creation request, then at most one bounded detail read. Return native
        acceptance separately from observed readability, membership and ownership;
        failed verification never discards acceptance or implies no group was created.
        No membership repair, owner change, web workflow, cleanup or retry occurs.

name: update_group
description:
Rename one membership-visible group without changing its members or owner.

        Native REST access is member-scoped, not owner-only. Existing sharing
        assignments remain attached to the renamed group. No automatic retry occurs.

name: delete_group
description:
Delete the group and its memberships, sharing links and group model rights.

        Source projects/documents remain, but members may lose access derived from
        this group. This is not removal of one member or one sharing grant. Native
        REST access is member-scoped, including for staff; no owner-only claim is made.
        No automatic retry or speculative read after successful deletion occurs.

name: share_project
description:
Add project access for one known username or current member group.

        Existing grants remain. Project access includes current and future
        accessible documents. The server decides permission; no owner-only rule
        is assumed. This API has no revoke, role or expiration option. Return
        native updated metadata after one POST, without a follow-up read.

ShareGroup.description: Share with a group in the caller's native membership scope.
ShareGroup.title: ShareGroup

ShareUser.description: Share with a known username, even outside the visible user directory.
ShareUser.title: ShareUser

name: share_document
description:
Add document access for one known username or current member group.

        Existing grants remain. Other project, group or ownership relationships
        may also grant access. The server decides permission; no owner-only rule
        is assumed. This API has no revoke, role or expiration option. Return
        native updated metadata after one POST, without a follow-up read.

ShareGroup.description: Share with a group in the caller's native membership scope.
ShareGroup.title: ShareGroup

ShareUser.description: Share with a known username, even outside the visible user directory.
ShareUser.title: ShareUser

name: list_projects
description:
List accessible projects with native name/tag filters and ordering.

        Follows pagination and preserves expanded sharing, tags and new fields.
        Native OR tag queries can return duplicate rows; counts are not rewritten.

ProjectFilters.description: Project ordering whitelist; omitted ordering uses the server default.
ProjectFilters.title: ProjectFilters

name: get_project
description: Read project metadata by primary key.

name: list_documents
description:
List accessible documents, preserving all native fields and pagination.

        Optional project filter is a numeric ID; document create/move uses a slug.
        Supports name/tag filters and ordering without deduplicating native rows.

DocumentFilters.description: Filter by numeric project ID; document writes instead use project slugs.
DocumentFilters.title: DocumentFilters

name: get_document
description: Read document metadata and its available transcription layers.

name: list_pages
description: List pages, optionally filtering names/filenames and sorting server-side.

PageFilters.description: Native name/filename substring search and ordered sort fields.
PageFilters.title: PageFilters

name: get_page
description: Read a page's metadata, image references and processing state.

name: list_lines
description: Read segmented lines for a page.

name: list_regions
description: Read segmented regions for a page.

name: list_transcriptions
description: List transcription layers and their primary keys.

name: get_page_transcriptions
description: Read page text/confidence/history, optionally filtered to one layer.

name: create_project
description:
Create a project with optional guidelines and personal tag IDs.

        Existing name-only calls remain valid. Repetition may create duplicates.
        Omitted settings retain native defaults; supplied tag arrays are complete.

ProjectCreateSettings.description: Optional native guidelines and complete personal-tag assignment.
ProjectCreateSettings.title: ProjectCreateSettings

name: create_transcription
description: Create an empty transcription layer in an existing document.

name: list_scripts
description: List writing systems; use their name in create_document.main_script.

name: create_document
description: Create an empty document; project is a slug, main_script a script name.

DocumentCreate.description: Create a document in a project identified by slug.
DocumentCreate.title: DocumentCreate

name: update_document
description:
Change settings or move a document to another project slug.

        Tags replace all assignments; [] clears them. A move with tags omitted
        retains existing assignments, even from the old project. Scope preflight
        checks supplied tags against the target project, without locking edits.

DocumentPatch.description: Rename, move project, or change document reading conventions.
DocumentPatch.title: DocumentPatch

name: rename_project
description: Rename a project while preserving its sharing settings.

name: upload_page
description:
Upload an image; a matching original filename can replace an existing page.

        Generates a card thumbnail and queues conversion. Use a unique filename
        when a new page is required; do not assume every upload creates a page.

PageUpload.description: Upload an existing image from this machine or a mounted volume.
PageUpload.title: PageUpload

name: update_page
description:
Edit page metadata, including document-enabled typology.

        original_filename changes stored metadata, not the image path.
        max_avg_confidence is a stored summary, not a confidence computation.
        Image replacement and ordering use their separate tools.

PagePatch.description: Editable page metadata; ordering uses the move tool.
PagePatch.title: PagePatch

name: delete_document
description: Permanently delete a document, its pages and transcriptions.

name: delete_project
description: Permanently delete a project, its documents and cascading page content.

name: delete_page
description: Delete a page and its segmentation and transcriptions.

name: update_project
description:
Update project name, guidelines or complete personal-tag assignments.

        Tags replace all assignments; [] clears them. Guidelines accept null or
        blank to clear. Preflight reads do not lock records against other edits.

ProjectPatch.description: Change project fields; tags replace all personal-tag assignments.
ProjectPatch.title: ProjectPatch

name: get_document_statistics
description:
Get native geometry/annotation counts, including untyped entries.

        Defaults may be cached for an hour. refresh=true recomputes; without
        ordering it also updates the default cache. These counts are not
        transcription characters or job progress.
        Ordering by typology applies to geometry, taxonomy to annotations;
        the other category retains native frequency ordering.

StatisticsOptions.description: Default statistics can be cached for one hour; refresh updates that cache.
StatisticsOptions.title: StatisticsOptions

name: list_document_page_ids
description: Return a raw list of all page IDs in native page order, possibly empty.

name: find_pages_by_type
description:
Get per-page counts for one region/line type or annotation taxonomy.

        type_id='none' selects untyped elements. Geometry results use
        document_part_id; annotation results use part_id. Preserve native keys.

ElementQuery.description: Find pages containing a type, or none for untyped elements.
ElementQuery.title: ElementQuery

name: list_metadata
description:
List every metadata association for one document or page.

        Follow all pagination and preserve duplicate rows and native fields.
        This lists associations, not all global key definitions or references.

DocumentMetadataTarget.description: Metadata associations belonging to one readable document.
DocumentMetadataTarget.title: DocumentMetadataTarget

PageMetadataTarget.description: Metadata associations for a page checked within its parent document.
PageMetadataTarget.title: PageMetadataTarget

name: get_metadata
description: Read one metadata association within the specified document or page.

DocumentMetadataTarget.description: Metadata associations belonging to one readable document.
DocumentMetadataTarget.title: DocumentMetadataTarget

PageMetadataTarget.description: Metadata associations for a page checked within its parent document.
PageMetadataTarget.title: PageMetadataTarget

name: create_metadata
description:
Create a metadata association with a nested shared key name and value.

        Repeated creation can create duplicate association rows. A key name already
        used with a different CIDOC identifier can fail rather than merge. Omit
        cidoc_id to leave it unspecified; explicit null or blank are native values.
        This is not an upsert and no automatic retry is performed.

DocumentMetadataTarget.description: Metadata associations belonging to one readable document.
DocumentMetadataTarget.title: DocumentMetadataTarget

MetadataCreate.description: Create an association, allowing native duplicate rows without upserting.
MetadataCreate.title: MetadataCreate

MetadataKey.description: Native shared key selection; omitted CIDOC differs from explicit null.
MetadataKey.title: MetadataKey

PageMetadataTarget.description: Metadata associations for a page checked within its parent document.
PageMetadataTarget.title: PageMetadataTarget

name: update_metadata
description: Replace only this association's value; its shared key is unchanged.

DocumentMetadataTarget.description: Metadata associations belonging to one readable document.
DocumentMetadataTarget.title: DocumentMetadataTarget

MetadataValuePatch.description: Change only this association's value, without editing its global key.
MetadataValuePatch.title: MetadataValuePatch

PageMetadataTarget.description: Metadata associations for a page checked within its parent document.
PageMetadataTarget.title: PageMetadataTarget

name: update_shared_metadata_key
description:
Edit the GLOBAL shared key used by this metadata association.

        Renaming or changing CIDOC affects every document/page using that key,
        including unrelated records. The API cannot enumerate all references.
        This is not local relabeling or rebinding. Native updates are not atomic;
        uniqueness failures can occur. This tool sends only nested key changes,
        never a value change in the same request, and never automatically retries.

DocumentMetadataTarget.description: Metadata associations belonging to one readable document.
DocumentMetadataTarget.title: DocumentMetadataTarget

PageMetadataTarget.description: Metadata associations for a page checked within its parent document.
PageMetadataTarget.title: PageMetadataTarget

SharedMetadataKeyPatch.description: Changes to a global definition, affecting every association using it.
SharedMetadataKeyPatch.title: SharedMetadataKeyPatch

name: delete_metadata
description:
Delete only this document/page metadata association.

        The global key, other associations and document/page content remain.
        Native bodyless 204 success is returned without a follow-up read.

DocumentMetadataTarget.description: Metadata associations belonging to one readable document.
DocumentMetadataTarget.title: DocumentMetadataTarget

PageMetadataTarget.description: Metadata associations for a page checked within its parent document.
PageMetadataTarget.title: PageMetadataTarget

name: list_tags
description:
List every tag definition in one scope, preserving native pagination data.

        personal_projects selects the current user's tags for projects.
        project_documents selects tags for documents in the specified project.
        These are definitions, not a list of assignments to individual records.

PersonalProjectTags.description: Select the authenticated user's personal definitions for tagging projects.
PersonalProjectTags.title: PersonalProjectTags

ProjectDocumentTags.description: Select definitions shared by documents within a single project.
ProjectDocumentTags.title: ProjectDocumentTags

name: get_tag
description: Read one tag definition within its personal or project scope.

PersonalProjectTags.description: Select the authenticated user's personal definitions for tagging projects.
PersonalProjectTags.title: PersonalProjectTags

ProjectDocumentTags.description: Select definitions shared by documents within a single project.
ProjectDocumentTags.title: ProjectDocumentTags

name: create_tag
description:
Create a tag definition for personal projects or one project's documents.

        Omit color for the server default. Color is nonblank and at most seven
        characters; server validation remains authoritative. Creation does not
        assign the tag to any record. Conflicting names remain native errors.

PersonalProjectTags.description: Select the authenticated user's personal definitions for tagging projects.
PersonalProjectTags.title: PersonalProjectTags

ProjectDocumentTags.description: Select definitions shared by documents within a single project.
ProjectDocumentTags.title: ProjectDocumentTags

TagCreate.description: Omit color to retain the server's generated default.
TagCreate.title: TagCreate

name: update_tag
description:
Rename or recolor a definition everywhere it is assigned in its scope.

        Omit unchanged fields; null and empty patches are unsupported. This does
        not relabel a single project's or document's assignment independently.
        Preflight reads do not lock the row; native permission errors propagate.

PersonalProjectTags.description: Select the authenticated user's personal definitions for tagging projects.
PersonalProjectTags.title: PersonalProjectTags

ProjectDocumentTags.description: Select definitions shared by documents within a single project.
ProjectDocumentTags.title: ProjectDocumentTags

TagPatch.description: Edit a definition without accepting empty or explicitly null changes.
TagPatch.title: TagPatch

name: delete_tag
description:
Delete a definition and unassign it from every record in that scope.

        Projects, documents and their content remain. To unassign only one record,
        replace that record's tag array instead. Native 204 means success; this
        operation is not automatically retried or followed by a speculative read.

PersonalProjectTags.description: Select the authenticated user's personal definitions for tagging projects.
PersonalProjectTags.title: PersonalProjectTags

ProjectDocumentTags.description: Select definitions shared by documents within a single project.
ProjectDocumentTags.title: ProjectDocumentTags

name: list_collections
description: List all collections owned by the current user, with full pagination.

name: get_collection
description: Read owned collection metadata; default layers are not membership.

name: create_collection
description:
Create an owned collection and optionally its initial page/layer pairs.

        Default transcriptions are UI selections and do not add/change members.
        The native operation is not atomic: failure may leave partial records.

CollectionCreate.description: Create a named collection with optional defaults and initial members.
CollectionCreate.title: CollectionCreate

CollectionMember.description: A page/layer pair with document context used only for scope preflight.
CollectionMember.title: CollectionMember

name: update_collection
description:
Update metadata or replace all page/layer pairs in one native PATCH.

        Omitted items preserve membership; [] clears it. Default-layer changes
        do not alter members. Changes can affect already queued training because
        workers read membership at execution. No snapshot, lock or atomicity is
        provided; failure may leave partial changes. Do not automatically retry.

CollectionMember.description: A page/layer pair with document context used only for scope preflight.
CollectionMember.title: CollectionMember

CollectionPatch.description: Edit metadata and optionally replace the entire collection membership.
CollectionPatch.title: CollectionPatch

name: delete_collection
list_collection_items
description: Read all current page/layer pairs, preserving native item metadata.

name: train_collection_recognizer
description:
Queue recognition training from every saved collection page/layer pair.

        The collection must be nonempty and all sources currently readable. Source
        text must supply usable ground truth; acceptance does not prove sufficiency.
        Omit model and supply model_name to create one; override=false clones a base.
        Overwrite requires an owned, stopped model even with model_name; that name
        does not rename an overwritten model. Failure can delete the target model.
        Membership is read at execution, so later edits can change the dataset.
        The native model_id identifies the target, not completion. Use model reports
        and checkpoints; collection task/group attribution is unavailable. No retry,
        per-request hyperparameters, global transcription or page subset is offered.

CollectionTraining.description: Training uses saved collection membership, without per-request page filters.
CollectionTraining.title: CollectionTraining

name: train_collection_segmenter
description:
Queue segmentation training from all saved collection pages' geometry.

        Requires at least two distinct readable pages for training/validation.
        Saved layer references are checked, though segmentation uses geometry.
        Equal region/line type names across documents are combined; line offset
        comes from the first page. D-FINE fine-tuning is unsupported upstream.
        Omit model and supply model_name to create one; override=false clones a base.
        Overwrite requires an owned, stopped model regardless of model_name, which
        does not rename it. Failure can delete the target. Membership is not frozen.
        Native model_id confirms the target only; inspect model reports/checkpoints.
        No collection task/group attribution or automatic retry is available.

CollectionTraining.description: Training uses saved collection membership, without per-request page filters.
CollectionTraining.title: CollectionTraining

name: align_document
description:
Align an active transcription to owned reference text or a local UTF-8 TXT.

        Required acknowledge_target_reuse=true accepts that layer_name can reuse
        and modify existing text, including hidden archived targets. The source
        layer's name is always rejected after trimming. Target absence cannot be
        guaranteed. A direct file upload creates an owned witness while queuing.
        Omit parts/types for all. merge=false leaves old unmatched target text;
        merge=true can copy source text outside selected regions. full_doc=true
        reads all source pages even when output parts select only some pages.
        Beam and offset search explicitly disable each other; offset zero is valid.
        Success is native acceptance, not completed or quality-checked output.
        Optional tracking returns unconfirmed group candidates and survives read
        failures. Use task reports with method core.tasks.align. Native Passim
        availability, rollback and precise alignment cancellation are not assured.

AlignmentJob.description: Reference-text alignment may reuse text in existing or hidden target layers.
AlignmentJob.title: AlignmentJob

BeamSearch.description: Beam search explicitly disables max-offset search in the native request.
BeamSearch.title: BeamSearch

ExistingWitness.description: Reuse a textual witness visible through the current user's owned route.
ExistingWitness.title: ExistingWitness

OffsetSearch.description: Offset search explicitly disables native default beam search, including zero.
OffsetSearch.title: OffsetSearch

UploadedWitness.description: Upload UTF-8 text directly in alignment, preserving original file bytes.
UploadedWitness.title: UploadedWitness

name: force_align_pages
description:
Replace character positions/confidences in an existing transcription layer.

        Uses a readable recognition model and existing text/geometry; it does not
        rewrite text, geometry or create a layer. Native document-scoped validation
        permits archived layers, so no active-only layer lookup is imposed here.
        Model metadata does not prove binary compatibility. Omit parts for all pages.
        One request queues page jobs without a group; failures may leave some jobs
        queued or graphs changed. No MCP retry occurs, but the backend may retry.
        Inspect core.tasks.forced_align reports; acceptance is not completion or
        proof of model attribution. No automatic graph backup or rollback exists.

ForcedAlignmentJob.description: Replace character graphs in the specified layer using a readable model.
ForcedAlignmentJob.title: ForcedAlignmentJob

name: list_textual_witnesses
description: List all current-user-owned witnesses with full strict pagination.

name: get_textual_witness
description: Read owned witness metadata, retaining native fields and file references.

name: upload_textual_witness
description:
Upload UTF-8 .txt once, acknowledging uncertain native owner assignment.

        Some server versions create ownerless inaccessible witnesses. Required
        acknowledge_unverified_ownership=true accepts that risk. A successful
        native POST is reported as accepted separately from one ownership
        readback; failed readback never hides acceptance or triggers a retry.

WitnessUpload.description: Upload text once, acknowledging that native creation may leave no owner.
WitnessUpload.title: WitnessUpload

name: update_textual_witness
description:
Rename or replace an owned witness file, preserving omitted fields.

        Replacement keeps exact UTF-8 bytes and can affect queued consumers.
        It does not rewrite completed alignment output or promise rollback.

WitnessPatch.description: Rename or replace an owned witness; omitted fields remain unchanged.
WitnessPatch.title: WitnessPatch

name: delete_textual_witness
description:
Delete an owned witness; queued consumers may fail afterward.

        Deletion does not cancel jobs or guarantee secure physical file erasure.

name: download_textual_witness
description:
Save owned witness bytes to a new file outside the scan-only Books archive.

        Destination and .part must be unused; interrupted partials are preserved.
        Return byte count and local SHA-256 after completion, without claiming
        a native checksum exists. Foreign, signed or redirected URLs are refused.

name: get_page_by_order
description:
Read a page by zero-based order, distinct from its page ID.

        Follows only one same-origin redirect to this document's page detail.
        Missing/out-of-bounds order and unexpected redirect targets are errors.

name: rotate_page
description:
Rotate clockwise by a nonzero integer from -359 through 359 degrees.

        Expands the canvas and transforms lines, regions and image annotations;
        transcription character graphs stay unchanged. Returns synchronous done,
        not a job ID; remaining thumbnails may still be queued. Files/rows can
        change partially on failure: inspect before retrying. Never auto-retries.

name: crop_page
description:
Destructively crop within current image bounds using integer corners.

        Overwrites the image and translates line/region geometry without clipping
        outside coordinates. Image annotations and character graphs are unchanged.
        Does not refresh thumbnails, file size or reading order. Returns native
        done, without a job ID. Failures can leave partial changes; inspect before
        retrying. No automatic retry or recovery of discarded pixels is provided.

CropBox.description: Integer corners in the current image, with a strictly positive area.
CropBox.title: CropBox

name: bulk_move_pages
description:
Move a complete page selection at an original-order insertion index.

        Index -1 appends; otherwise use 0 through the current page count. Selected
        pages retain their current relative order, irrespective of supplied ID
        order. Preflight checks every ID but does not lock concurrent edits.
        Returns the native moved status; no updated list or job ID is invented.

BulkPageMove.description: A complete distinct selection and insertion position; -1 appends.
BulkPageMove.title: BulkPageMove

name: replace_page_image
description:
Replace a page image from an existing file on the MCP server machine.

        Sends multipart image plus its measured byte count. Existing geometry and
        text are not resized or reprojected. PATCH does not run upload conversion,
        thumbnail or duplicate-filename hooks. Arbitrary image_file_size edits are
        not exposed; original_filename can be changed separately with update_page.

name: create_line_transcription
description: Write text for an existing segmented line in a transcription layer.

CharacterGraph.description: Optional character, polygon and confidence fields from the server schema.
CharacterGraph.title: CharacterGraph

LineText.description: A line's text in a particular transcription layer.
LineText.title: LineText

name: update_line_transcription
description: Edit a text record by its PK; changed line/layer links must stay in scope.

CharacterGraph.description: Optional character, polygon and confidence fields from the server schema.
CharacterGraph.title: CharacterGraph

TextPatch.description: Edit text, character graphs, confidence or scoped line/layer references.
TextPatch.title: TextPatch

TextTarget.description: The complete address of one line transcription record.
TextTarget.title: TextTarget

name: get_line_transcription
description: Read one text record, including graphs, confidence and available history.

TextTarget.description: The complete address of one line transcription record.
TextTarget.title: TextTarget

name: rename_transcription
description: Rename a transcription layer without rewriting its line text.

name: delete_transcription
description: Archive/rename a layer, retaining text; the manual layer is protected.

name: delete_line_transcription
description: Delete one line transcription record, keeping its segmented line.

TextTarget.description: The complete address of one line transcription record.
TextTarget.title: TextTarget

name: bulk_create_line_transcriptions
description:
Create line text/graphs in bulk after checking page and layer membership.

        Reject duplicate line/layer pairs. Server normalization is preserved.
        The native bulk path does not run single-create progress/author hooks.
        Preflight is not a lock; inspect remote state before retrying a failure.

CharacterGraph.description: Optional character, polygon and confidence fields from the server schema.
CharacterGraph.title: CharacterGraph

LineText.description: A line's text in a particular transcription layer.
LineText.title: LineText

name: bulk_update_line_transcriptions
description:
Update existing text-record PKs, checking all page/layer references first.

        This native operation is non-atomic: a failed response can follow saved
        earlier rows. No automatic retry. Re-read records after any failure.
        Omit unchanged fields; null clears graphs/average confidence only.
        Pause concurrent writers during preflight and submission.

BulkTextPatch.description: One existing line-transcription record in a bulk update.
BulkTextPatch.title: BulkTextPatch

CharacterGraph.description: Optional character, polygon and confidence fields from the server schema.
CharacterGraph.title: CharacterGraph

name: bulk_clear_line_transcriptions
description:
Blank selected text records through native bulk_delete; keep their rows.

        This clears content only. Graphs, confidence and existing history remain;
        the native action creates no history revision. IDs are text-record PKs,
        not segmented-line IDs. Preflight checks membership but is not a lock.

name: get_transcription
description: Read a document's transcription layer, comments and archived state.

name: update_transcription
description:
Edit layer name, archived state, comments or average-confidence metadata.

        Omit unchanged fields; null clears comments/average confidence. Archiving
        hides a layer but retains its line records. This does not recompute scores.

LayerPatch.description: Editable layer settings; archived layers retain their line records.
LayerPatch.title: LayerPatch

name: get_transcription_statistics
description:
Return nonempty-line count and stored-character frequencies for a layer.

        Sum the returned frequencies for the stored-character count. Stored
        markup is included; these are not normalized plain-text/grapheme counts.
        The server caches statistics for up to one hour. Preserve zero counts.

name: find_transcription_pages_by_character
description:
Locate pages containing one stored Unicode code point in a layer.

        Requires the newer parts_by_char endpoint. A multi-code-point grapheme
        must be queried by individual code point; stored markup is included.
        Page IDs and per-page counts come directly from the server.

name: create_line
description:
Create a line with a baseline or mask on line.document_part.

        Coordinates are image pixels. Optional region and typology references
        must belong to this page/document; external_id and order are editable.

LineCreate.description: Single-line creation explicitly names its parent page.
LineCreate.title: LineCreate

name: update_line
description:
Edit line geometry, region, typology, external_id or reading-order index.

        Omit unchanged fields. Null clears nullable fields, but the final line
        must retain a baseline or mask. Supplied references are checked first.

ElementTarget.description: Address an existing line or region inside a page.
ElementTarget.title: ElementTarget

LinePatch.description: Omitted fields survive; nullable geometry requires final-state preflight.
LinePatch.title: LinePatch

name: create_region
description:
Create a region polygon with optional typology, external_id and locked.

        Explicit locking requires writable server support. Locked is an editor
        cutting preference, not a permission lock; API edits remain possible.

RegionCreate.description: A page region polygon in image pixels.
RegionCreate.title: RegionCreate

name: update_region
description:
Edit a region polygon, typology, external_id or editor locking flag.

        Explicit locked changes probe writable server support before submitting.
        Locking does not prevent API edits or deletion. Omit unchanged fields;
        null clears typology/external_id but cannot remove the region polygon.

ElementTarget.description: Address an existing line or region inside a page.
ElementTarget.title: ElementTarget

RegionPatch.description: Edit supplied region fields without clearing its required outline.
RegionPatch.title: RegionPatch

name: delete_line
description: Delete a segmented line, attached text/history and cascaded relations.

ElementTarget.description: Address an existing line or region inside a page.
ElementTarget.title: ElementTarget

name: delete_region
description: Delete a region; related line treatment follows server rules.

ElementTarget.description: Address an existing line or region inside a page.
ElementTarget.title: ElementTarget

name: move_page
description: Reorder one page within its document using a zero-based index.

PagePosition.description: Zero-based page position within the same document.
PagePosition.title: PagePosition

name: reorder_lines
description:
Change explicit line reading-order indexes after checking page membership.

        Duplicate IDs are rejected; the native response lists whole-page orders.

LineOrder.description: Explicit line order changes within one page.
LineOrder.title: LineOrder

LinePosition.description: A line's primary key and new reading-order index.
LinePosition.title: LinePosition

name: get_line
description: Read one segmented line including its detailed transcription records.

ElementTarget.description: Address an existing line or region inside a page.
ElementTarget.title: ElementTarget

name: get_region
description: Read one region, including locking when supported by the server.

ElementTarget.description: Address an existing line or region inside a page.
ElementTarget.title: ElementTarget

name: bulk_create_lines
description:
Create segmented lines and optional nested text in document-owned layers.

        Coordinates are image pixels. A baseline or mask is required. Native
        creation is atomic on the audited server; preflight is not a lock.

BulkLineCreate.description: New line geometry with optional text in document-owned layers.
BulkLineCreate.title: BulkLineCreate

CharacterGraph.description: Optional character, polygon and confidence fields from the server schema.
CharacterGraph.title: CharacterGraph

NestedTranscription.description: The bulk endpoint assigns the new line ID; only its layer is supplied.
NestedTranscription.title: NestedTranscription

name: bulk_update_lines
description:
Edit existing segmented lines with one native PUT after scoped preflight.

        A later save failure can leave earlier edits applied. Never retry blindly;
        re-read affected records. Omitted fields remain, explicit null clears
        nullable fields. Every final line needs a baseline or mask.

BulkLinePatch.description: An existing line identity and supplied changes within the URL page.
BulkLinePatch.title: BulkLinePatch

name: bulk_delete_lines
description:
Delete selected geometry, attached text/history and cascaded relations.

        Every selected ID must belong to this page. Returned deleted records are
        not a complete backup of all cascaded objects. Preflight is not a lock.

name: merge_lines
description:
Replace 2-8 distinct baseline-bearing lines with one merged line.

        Original lines are deleted. The server chooses geometric/text order,
        region and type; character graphs, confidence and history are not
        preserved. The mask may need explicit regeneration afterward.

name: regenerate_line_masks
description:
Queue mask regeneration for selected lines or all eligible page lines.

        A status ok response means submitted, not completed. The native response
        has no task ID. Omit line_ids for all lines; an empty list is invalid.

name: recalculate_line_order
description:
Replace manual line ordering using page geometry and document direction.

        This native action runs synchronously and returns whole-page line orders.

name: list_models
description: List models, job type (1 segmentation, 2 recognition), and training state.

name: upload_model
description: Register a local Kraken model for segmentation (1) or recognition (2).

ModelUpload.description: Upload a local Kraken model: job 1 segments, job 2 recognizes text.
ModelUpload.title: ModelUpload

name: get_model
description: Read model training progress, versions and available accuracy metadata.

name: list_tasks
description:
List own reports: 0 queued, 1 running, 2 crashed, 3 done, 4 canceled.

        Document/group/order filters run on the server. State and exact method
        filters run locally after all pages. Ordering accepts queued_at,
        started_at, done_at, comma-separated and optionally prefixed with '-'.
        document_part is a display label, not a page ID. No arguments retains
        the existing response shape; local filters return a results envelope.

name: get_task
description: Read a task report's status, messages and timestamps.

name: segment_pages
description: Queue automatic segmentation; override replaces existing geometry.

Segmentation.description: Require explicit pages; preserve existing segmentation unless overridden.
Segmentation.title: Segmentation

name: transcribe_pages
description: Queue OCR/HTR; existing text in the selected layer may be replaced.

Recognition.description: Transcribe selected pages with an existing recognizer and layer.
Recognition.title: Recognition

name: train_recognition
description:
Queue recognition training; override replaces an owned, idle model.

        Otherwise an existing model is cloned. track=true wraps acceptance with
        candidate task groups, never a proven association or completed result.
        Monitoring failure does not undo acceptance and must not trigger a retry.

RecognitionTraining.description: Recognition training uses a ground-truth transcription layer.
RecognitionTraining.title: RecognitionTraining

name: train_segmentation
description:
Queue segmentation training from at least two distinct segmented pages.

        override=true replaces an owned, idle model; otherwise it is cloned.
        track=true reports acceptance and unproven candidate task groups.
        A monitoring failure never causes automatic resubmission.

SegmentationTraining.description: Segmentation training requires at least two distinct page images.
SegmentationTraining.title: SegmentationTraining

name: cancel_task
description:
Cancel a report with DOCUMENT-WIDE training/import cleanup side effects.

        Even with one task ID, the server also marks all document training models
        and imports canceled. Prefer dedicated model/import cancellation for those
        jobs. Requires document owner/staff; refresh reports afterward.

name: cancel_page_tasks
description: Cancel pending processing for one page.

name: cancel_model_training
description: Stop training an existing model using the dedicated cancel action.

name: update_model
description:
Rename or update an owned model's job type/storage-size metadata.

        job is 1 for segmentation or 2 for recognition. Omit unchanged fields;
        nulls and document association edits are unsupported. Job/size edits
        require stopped training. Changing job metadata does not convert weights.
        file_size is storage accounting; file replacement calculates it for you.

ModelUpdate.description: Omit unchanged fields; these metadata fields cannot be cleared with null.
ModelUpdate.title: ModelUpdate

name: replace_model_file
description:
Replace an owned, idle model's weights from a local MCP-host file.

        Replaces the current file reference and size; this does not create a
        checkpoint backup. Download the current file first if it must be retained.
        Server file validation and permissions still apply.

name: delete_model
description:
Delete an owned, idle model and its server-managed relationships.

        This does not delete document transcriptions. Download files/checkpoints
        to retain them; upstream may remove stored model files when deleting.

name: list_model_versions
description:
List advertised checkpoints with revision IDs and available training metrics.

        File references do not prove bytes still exist. Use download_model with
        a revision to retrieve one; no checkpoint revert/delete REST action exists.

name: get_model_documents
description:
Read document associations; the audited REST API cannot bind/unbind them.

        Segmentation, transcription and training create associations as a side
        effect. Do not submit a processing job solely to edit this relationship.

name: download_model
description:
Save current model weights or one advertised checkpoint on the MCP host.

        Omit revision for the current file. Destination and .part must be new and
        outside the scan-only Books archive. Return byte count/SHA-256 only after
        transfer completion. Missing files remain errors; redirects are refused.

name: list_document_tasks
description:
List document task counts and last-start timestamps, following pagination.

        Name matches a substring. State selects documents with that state; counts
        still include their historical reports in every state. user_id is for
        staff only; nonstaff results follow the server's document ownership rules.

name: list_task_groups
description: List all document job groups with state counts and affected-page counts.

name: get_task_group
description:
Read group state buckets, counts and timestamps; inspect every bucket.

        A bucket's done_at is its latest report finish, not proof the group
        succeeded. page_count counts associated pages, not completed pages.

name: get_document_job_status
description:
Summarize the current user's task reports, including failure messages.

        Filter by group to monitor one submission. Without a group, historical
        jobs are included. terminal_percent includes failures/cancellations and
        is not page progress. Empty/unknown reports never mean successful completion.

name: get_import_status
description:
Read visible import task history, messages and report state counts.

        Filter by group to narrow reports; without it old imports are included.
        Inspect timestamps and messages, including skipped-file warnings. A finished
        import report does not prove separately queued image conversion is finished.
        No visible reports does not prove no import exists. Native import record
        status, processed/total counts and progress percentages are not exposed.

name: cancel_document_tasks
cancel_document_import
description:
Cancel the latest document import through its dedicated server action.

        This cannot select an arbitrary historical import. Already stopped imports
        return an upstream error; some versions return HTTP 500 when none exists.
        Task history alone cannot reliably prove that a cancelable import exists.
        Latest is selected when the action runs, so concurrent imports can change
        its target. Cancellation before report attachment may not stop a queued
        task; existing image/text changes are not rolled back.

name: get_training_report
description:
Read model metrics/checkpoints and optionally selected training tasks.

        A supplied document/group is caller-selected, not a proven model link.
        Without a group, document task reports include historical training.
        Idle models are not proof of successful training. Server validation
        scores are not universal CER/WER metrics. Artifact existence is unchecked;
        use download_model to verify a current file or checkpoint's availability.

name: download_register
description:
Download ALL available scans directly to NAS with a checksum manifest.

        Requires a new catalogue folder. Existing destinations are never overwritten.
        Download completion does not mean visual inspection or transcription completion.

RegisterDownload.description: Catalogue identifiers used for the fixed NAS book folder.
RegisterDownload.title: RegisterDownload

name: export_transcriptions
description:
Save a layer as UTF-8 text or JSON locally in page/line order.

        Works with API-token authentication without waiting for server notifications.
        Existing files are never overwritten. JSON preserves line IDs and revisions;
        this is a layer export, not the native full-document JSON archive.

TranscriptionExport.description: Export a layer to a new local file, all pages unless explicitly selected.
TranscriptionExport.title: TranscriptionExport

name: request_server_export
description:
Queue native ALTO, PAGE XML, text, JSON, OpenITI or TEI export once.

        OpenITI/TEI require server enablement. Omitted pages and region types mean
        all; the selected transcription must be active even with all_transcriptions.
        JSON supports ZIP/tar.gz, metadata, annotations, model catalogue metadata
        (not weights), all layers including archived ones, and partial author-name
        anonymization. Missing images may be skipped. JSON has no native restore.
        Character boxes apply to ALTO/PAGE/JSON and may be invalidated by editing.
        Success means accepted, not complete, and returns no task/group/download ID.
        Inspect document task reports and list_downloads; download.task_report_id
        links a file to its report, not to this submission. Completion notifications
        can also supply a URL for download_export. No automatic retry is performed.

ServerExport.description: Native export options; JSON-only settings require the JSON archive format.
ServerExport.title: ServerExport

name: download_export
description: Save a completed same-server export URL to a new local file with checksum.

ExportDownload.description: Download an export URL supplied by an eScriptorium notification.
ExportDownload.title: ExportDownload

name: import_document_file
description:
Queue PDF, ZIP, ALTO or PAGE XML through the legacy plural import form.

        Use submit_document_import for explicit modes, IIIF/METS and layer IDs.
        Local paths refer to the MCP host. Even override=false may replace text or
        matching images. override=true deletes segmentation and attached text/history
        across layers. Submission is not completion; inspect task reports for errors
        and skipped files. No automatic retry or resume is performed by this tool.

DocumentImport.description: Import a supported PDF, image archive or transcription file.
DocumentImport.title: DocumentImport

name: list_downloads
description:
List all current-user download records, following every page safely.

        task_report_id filters locally after pagination. A nonnull report ID links
        an artifact to that report, not to an unconfirmed submission. Expired rows
        may remain visible; absence does not prove an export failed. Without a
        filter the native collection shape and metadata are preserved.

name: get_download
description:
Read owned download metadata without incrementing file access counters.

        fingerprint is exactly 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Expired rows
        can still have metadata while file retrieval returns 404. Metadata does
        not prove stored bytes exist; server-reported file_url is informational.

name: download_generated_export
description:
Save a generated export to a new file on the MCP server's host.

        Verify metadata identity and byte size, then stream through the fixed
        authenticated file route; file_url cannot choose the request destination.
        File access increments server counters. Destination and .part must be new,
        use portable names and stay outside the scan-only Books archive. Failed
        transfers retain partial files. Return bytes/SHA-256 only after exclusive
        publication; that checksum proves local bytes, not archive completeness.
        Expired or missing files return errors. Redirects and retries are refused.

name: delete_download
description:
Delete one owned download record and ask eScriptorium to unlink its file.

        The native bodyless 204 is success; the request is not retried. Upstream
        can suppress file-removal failures, so success does not prove secure
        erasure or physical removal. Save needed bytes before deleting the record.

name: submit_document_import
description:
Submit PDF, XML/ZIP, IIIF or METS through the modern document import API.

        Local file_path must exist on the MCP host. URLs are fetched by eScriptorium
        under its network policy; MCP does not download them or forward API tokens.
        IIIF supports Presentation 2 image-service manifests, all canvases; PDF and
        IIIF import images only. No Presentation 3 or JSON archive restore is offered.

        XML transcription_id selects a visible document layer by its name;
        name selects/creates a layer. METS name or prefix_transcription_id supplies
        a prefix for separate source layers, not an exact destination layer. Use
        absolute references in local METS XML or a self-contained METS ZIP.

        XML matches pages by original_filename; unmatched pages produce warnings.
        Even override=false can replace text/images. override=true deletes page
        lines/regions and their text/history across ALL layers. Image replacement
        does not promise geometry reprojection. Multi-page imports are not atomic.

        Success means accepted, not complete. Inspect reports for skipped-file
        warnings and separate image-conversion jobs. track=true returns uncertain
        new group candidates, never confirmed attribution. Native processed/total
        counters are unavailable; monitoring failure never warrants resubmission.

IiifUrl.description: Presentation 2 manifest fetched by eScriptorium, importing all canvases.
IiifUrl.title: IiifUrl

MetsFile.description: METS descriptor with absolute references, or a self-contained METS ZIP.
MetsFile.title: MetsFile

MetsUrl.description: METS descriptor fetched by eScriptorium; relative references use its URL.
MetsUrl.title: MetsUrl

PdfFile.description: A PDF on the MCP host; the server imports page images only.
PdfFile.title: PdfFile

XmlFile.description: ALTO/PAGE XML or ordinary ZIP, optionally targeting a document layer.
XmlFile.title: XmlFile

name: get_document_ontology
description: Read the document's allowed page, region and line types with actual IDs.

name: list_ontology_types
description: List public/template types; use get_document_ontology for assigned types.

name: create_ontology_type
description: Create/reuse a named type; this does not attach it to a document.

TypeDefinition.description: Name supported by both legacy and current ontology APIs.
TypeDefinition.title: TypeDefinition

name: update_ontology_type
description: Rename a type. Legacy/shared types affect every document using that ID.

TypeDefinition.description: Name supported by both legacy and current ontology APIs.
TypeDefinition.title: TypeDefinition

name: delete_ontology_type
description:
Delete a definition globally where permitted.

        Page/region/line references become untyped. Deleting an annotation
        type can cascade to taxonomies and their annotations.

        To remove it only from one document, use set_document_ontology instead.

name: set_document_ontology
description:
Replace supplied allowed-type lists, preserving omitted categories.

        Audit/reassign used types before removal. Newer servers may clear content
        assignments when dropping a document-owned type. Re-read resulting IDs.

OntologySelection.description: Replacement lists: omitted categories stay unchanged, empty lists clear.
OntologySelection.title: OntologySelection

name: add_document_ontology_type
description:
Create/reuse and attach a named type while keeping existing allowed types.

        Multiple requests are not atomic. If attachment fails, the created
        definition may remain. Re-read the document to obtain its assigned ID.

TypeDefinition.description: Name supported by both legacy and current ontology APIs.
TypeDefinition.title: TypeDefinition

name: list_annotation_components
description: List all annotation input fields and their allowed values in a document.

name: get_annotation_component
description: Read an annotation input field and its allowed values.

name: create_annotation_component
description: Create a document annotation field; empty allowed_values means free text.

AnnotationComponent.description: Named input field; an empty allowed-values list permits free text.
AnnotationComponent.title: AnnotationComponent

name: update_annotation_component
description: Rename a field or replace its allowed values; annotation text remains.

AnnotationComponentPatch.description: Change a component label or replace its allowed values.
AnnotationComponentPatch.title: AnnotationComponentPatch

name: delete_annotation_component
description: Delete an annotation field; associated annotation values may be deleted.

name: list_annotation_taxonomies
description: List annotation categories, optionally filtering image or text markers.

name: get_annotation_taxonomy
description: Read a complete annotation category before replacing its definition.

name: create_annotation_taxonomy
description: Create an annotation category; typology uses name, components use IDs.

AnnotationTaxonomy.description: Complete annotation display definition with document component IDs.
AnnotationTaxonomy.title: AnnotationTaxonomy

AnnotationType.description: An annotation type is resolved or created by its global name.
AnnotationType.title: AnnotationType

name: update_annotation_taxonomy
description:
Replace the full definition: supply every setting to preserve it.

        Read first; convert nested components to their IDs and typology to {name}.
        Explicit components=[] removes all fields; typology=null clears the type.
        Omitted display fields reset to defaults. Existing annotations remain.

AnnotationTaxonomyReplacement.description: Require explicit relations because the upstream PATCH replaces them.
AnnotationTaxonomyReplacement.title: AnnotationTaxonomyReplacement

AnnotationType.description: An annotation type is resolved or created by its global name.
AnnotationType.title: AnnotationType

name: delete_annotation_taxonomy
description: Delete an annotation category; its existing annotations may be deleted.

name: list_annotations
description: List page annotations; optionally filter text by transcription layer.

name: get_annotation
description: Read an annotation, component values and its server-generated W3C form.

AnnotationTarget.description: Address an annotation within a document and page.
AnnotationTarget.title: AnnotationTarget

name: delete_annotation
description: Delete an annotation and its component values from this page.

AnnotationTarget.description: Address an annotation within a document and page.
AnnotationTarget.title: AnnotationTarget

name: create_image_annotation
description: Create an image annotation on this page using a document taxonomy.

AnnotationValue.description: A field value; null clears its content but does not remove its relation.
AnnotationValue.title: AnnotationValue

ImageAnnotationCreate.description: Rectangle corners or polygon vertices, in integer image pixels.
ImageAnnotationCreate.title: ImageAnnotationCreate

name: update_image_annotation
description:
Update image fields; components upsert by ID, [] preserves existing values.

        Set a component value to null to clear it. Its relation remains because
        the upstream API has no component-value deletion endpoint.

AnnotationTarget.description: Address an annotation within a document and page.
AnnotationTarget.title: AnnotationTarget

AnnotationValue.description: A field value; null clears its content but does not remove its relation.
AnnotationValue.title: AnnotationValue

ImageAnnotationPatch.description: Update supplied fields while preserving omitted values and components.
ImageAnnotationPatch.title: ImageAnnotationPatch

name: create_text_annotation
description: Create a text span; use page line IDs and the document transcription ID.

AnnotationValue.description: A field value; null clears its content but does not remove its relation.
AnnotationValue.title: AnnotationValue

TextAnnotationCreate.description: Text span identified by line IDs, a layer ID and zero-based offsets.
TextAnnotationCreate.title: TextAnnotationCreate

name: update_text_annotation
description:
Update text fields; components upsert by ID, [] preserves existing values.

        Set a component value to null to clear it. Its relation remains because
        the upstream API has no component-value deletion endpoint.

AnnotationTarget.description: Address an annotation within a document and page.
AnnotationTarget.title: AnnotationTarget

AnnotationValue.description: A field value; null clears its content but does not remove its relation.
AnnotationValue.title: AnnotationValue

TextAnnotationPatch.description: Change a span, its layer, taxonomy or values; omitted fields stay intact.
TextAnnotationPatch.title: TextAnnotationPatch

name: patch_annotation_taxonomy
description:
Edit only supplied taxonomy fields, preserving omitted relations/settings.

        Explicit typology=null clears its relation; components=[] removes all fields.
        The API has no atomic conditional update: avoid concurrent taxonomy edits.

AnnotationType.description: An annotation type is resolved or created by its global name.
AnnotationType.title: AnnotationType

TaxonomyPatch.description: Only supplied fields change; null typology clears the relation.
TaxonomyPatch.title: TaxonomyPatch

name: merge_annotation_taxonomies
description:
Preview/apply reassignment of all source image/text annotations to target.

        Target must support every stored component and the same marker family.
        Existing values/geometry/text spans remain. Source deletion is opt-in and
        requires a clean rescan. Pause concurrent editing: upstream has no atomic
        conditional writes. Failures return partial progress; inspect before retry.

name: audit_document_ontology
description: Audit type usage, untyped content and invalid/duplicate labels.

name: replace_ontology_assignments
description:
Preview (default) or apply type replacement across an entire document.

        Null source selects untyped content; null target clears assignments.
        Writes are sequential, not atomic; avoid concurrent editing during repair.
        Returns partial progress on failure. Source removal affects this document only.

TypeReplacement.description: Preview or apply a document-wide type replacement; null means untyped.
TypeReplacement.title: TypeReplacement

name: merge_ontology_types
description:
Preview/apply a merge: reassign usage, then remove source from this document.

        Both definitions remain globally on legacy servers; no global deletion.
        Concurrent edits are not transactionally isolated. Inspect partial results.

name: get_ontology_capabilities
description:
Probe native import/export and project templates using GET and OPTIONS.

        A missing/denied parent stays an HTTP error. Endpoint 404 means absent
        or hidden, 403 means denied; neither is guessed to be a server version.
        Methods and serializer fields are reported where OPTIONS supplies them.

name: export_native_ontology
description:
Save native ontology YAML on the MCP host without overwriting files.

        Requires the server's native endpoint; use portable ontology backup on
        older servers. Project export can return 404 when no template is set.

name: import_native_ontology
description:
Apply server-native YAML/legacy JSON from the MCP host (maximum 16 MiB).

        Document import can replace definitions and affect annotations; project
        import sets the template for future documents. Preserve returned warnings.
        Unsupported/denied endpoints return capability evidence without writing.

name: get_project_ontology
description:
Read the default template for future documents; null means none set.

        Older servers return 404 for the unsupported endpoint.

name: delete_project_ontology
description: Clear the project template without changing existing documents.

name: get_ontology_type
description:
Read a public/template type; private document types may return 404.

        Use get_document_ontology for assigned document-owned type records.

name: update_ontology_type_color
description:
Set a region/line type color when exposed by this server's OPTIONS.

        Prefer #RRGGBB; blank or null clears the override. Permission rules
        still apply; public templates may be read-only.

name: export_ontology_snapshot
description:
Return versioned JSON ontology schema, excluding annotations/text/geometry.

        Save this result as JSON for backup or pass it to restore_ontology_snapshot.
        Component relations use names, so source database IDs are not required.

name: restore_ontology_snapshot
description:
Preview or add portable schema to a document; never delete existing schema.

        Conflicting same-name definitions stop all writes. Apply is non-atomic;
        failures report completed steps. Re-export to inspect state before retrying.
        Annotation instances, text and geometry are not restored by this tool.

AnnotationComponent.description: Named input field; an empty allowed-values list permits free text.
AnnotationComponent.title: AnnotationComponent

OntologySnapshot.description: Versioned schema; excludes annotation instances, text and geometry.
OntologySnapshot.title: OntologySnapshot

SnapshotTaxonomy.description: Annotation display settings with component and typology names.
SnapshotTaxonomy.title: SnapshotTaxonomy
